# Results analysis (generated by scripts/results_analysis.py)

## 1. GPT-2 held-out EK-FAC scaling (Figure 1)
- 1% series, 8 sizes: QLD 0.0083 -> 0.1161 nats (13.9x); power law alpha = 0.508 [0.454, 0.549], R^2(log) = 0.950
  - fit on <= 128k (alpha 0.557): power law predicts 512k 0.1643 (+41%); log-linear predicts 0.0881 (-24%)
  - fit on <= 256k (alpha 0.543): power law predicts 512k 0.1558 (+34%); log-linear predicts 0.1026 (-12%)
  - per-doubling gain: +135%, +49%, +35%, +4%, +84%, +35%, +14%
- top-40 series: QLD 0.0077-0.0184 nats; alpha = 0.091 [-0.099, 0.238], R^2 = 0.304
- 1% series restricted to 4k-64k (the Qwen range): alpha = 0.561, R^2 = 0.872
